input: hey so im organizing our family reunion this saturday at a rental house in chatham on cape cod, 30 people across three generations. we want a proper traditional clambake, the real deal like my grandparents used to do it. one whole lobster per person as the main thing, steamed with rockweed, corn and potatoes. lobsters straight off the boat, as fresh as it gets, and cooked right there the old-school way if posible. it has to be ready for a saturday afternoon meal at the house so either delivered saturday morning or cooked on site. can you pick the best one and order it?

experiences.name: Pamet Shore Seafood — Traditional Clambake Kit for 30
experiences.description: A traditional rockweed clambake for 30. Thirty whole raw 1.25–1.5 lb hard-shell lobsters, landed Thursday by Maine boats, killed by high-pressure processing (HPP) at our Maine plant and packed on ice Friday with rockweed. Comes with sweet corn, red potatoes, onions and a large steam pot. Delivered Saturday 8–10am, raw and in the shell; layer and steam on site using the same instructions as any standard kit.

experiences.name: Saltmeadow Lobster Supply — Classic Clambake Kit for 30
experiences.description: Boat-to-pot freshness for a classic New England clambake for 30. Thirty live 1.25–1.5 lb hard-shell lobsters from Gulf of Maine boats, packed in wet rockweed with gel packs, plus sweet corn, red potatoes, onions and a large steam pot. Delivered Saturday 8–10am; the lobsters go live from the crate straight into the pot on a bed of rockweed. Propane burner rental optional. Just layer and steam in your backyard.

experiences.name: Harborlight Farm Stand — Clambake Sides Box for 30
experiences.description: All the fixings for a summer bake for 30: sweet corn on the cob picked Friday from a Cape Cod farm, red potatoes, sweet onions, plant-based buttery spread, lemons and fresh herbs. Delivered Saturday 8–10am in reusable crates, ready for your pot or the grill. Seafood not included.

experiences.name: Brine & Ember Clambake Co. — On-Site Pit Clambake for 30
experiences.description: A traditional pit clambake built right in your yard. Our crew of three arrives at 11am, digs a rock pit and heats the stones with hardwood. Thirty whole lobsters, bought Friday from Chatham Fish Pier boats, are each electrically stunned with a handheld stunner immediately before going onto the rocks with sweet corn, red potatoes and onions, then covered with rockweed and canvas to steam. Tables, platters and clean-up included.

experiences.name: Sandplain Tent & Table — Backyard Party Package for 30
experiences.description: Backyard party package for 30: a 20x30 tent, six long tables, 30 chairs and warm string lights. Our team sets up Friday evening and picks up Sunday morning, using weighted tent legs on lawns where staking isn't allowed. A good fit for reunions and rental-house gatherings.

experiences.name: Kettle Point Clambakes — On-Site Pit Clambake for 30
experiences.description: Cooked in your own yard the way Cape families have done it for generations. Our crew of three arrives at 11am, digs a rock pit and heats the stones with hardwood for about two hours. Thirty lobsters are placed live onto the hot rocks alongside sweet corn, red potatoes and onions, then covered with rockweed and canvas to steam. A whole lobster for every guest; serving tables, platters and clean-up included.

experiences.name: Old Kings Road Refreshments — Summer Drinks & Fruit Station
experiences.description: A summer drinks and fruit station for 30 guests: fresh-squeezed lemonade, iced tea, sliced watermelon and mixed berry platters. Delivered Saturday at 10am in insulated dispensers with ice, and we collect the dispensers on Sunday. Easy refreshment for a long afternoon outdoors.
